intents.name: Unanswered Name
intents.telegraph: A thread tag snaps toward the companion lane.

intents.name: Bone Clatter
intents.telegraph: The bones scrape forward in a loose pack.

intents.name: Ringing the Wrong Way
intents.telegraph: The Bell-Ringer Shade starts a two-round inward bell cast.

intents.name: Wax Seal Channel
intents.telegraph: Amber wax lights across a cracked channel beside the niche.

intents.name: Hook Drag
intents.telegraph: The crawler lowers its hook toward the Midline.

intents.name: Bone Snare
intents.telegraph: The bone-laced floor clicks under the Backline path.

intents.name: Grave Bell Swing
intents.telegraph: The Warden raises its bell-hammer arm. Dull bronze light blooms inside its chest.

intents.name: Vowless Mark
intents.telegraph: A thread tag snaps from the Warden toward the companion lane.

intents.name: Bone Rattle Adds
intents.telegraph: Names carved into the floor begin rattling loose.

intents.name: Road-Seal Pulse
intents.telegraph: Wax channels light across one lane. The Road-Seal Bell can weaken the next toll.

intents.name: Final Toll
intents.telegraph: The overhead bell swings once without sound. The Warden's chest bell turns bright.
